text_to_sequence: convert a string of text to a sequence of symbol IDs using named cleaner functions
sequence_to_text: convert a sequence of symbol IDs back to a readable text string
code_to_sequence: convert a list of codes to a numeric sequence using a code dictionary with optional collapsing
sequence_to_code: convert a numeric sequence back to a space-separated list of codes using a code dictionary
sample_code_chunk: sample a random contiguous chunk of a given size from a code array and return start and end indices
